The workflow is valid. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_web_015
steps:
  - id: search_product
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/catalog/search"
      method: GET
      query: "{{trigger.search_query}}"
    output: search_results

  - id: authenticate_shopper
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      token: "{{trigger.auth_token}}"
    output: auth_context

  - id: validate_cart
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      data: "{{trigger.cart}}"
      schema: checkout_schema
    output: validated_cart

  - id: process_order
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      url: "https://orders.internal/process"
      method: POST
      payload:
        user: "{{auth_context.user_id}}"
        cart: "{{validated_cart}}"
        product: "{{search_results.selected_item}}"
    output: order_result

  - id: fulfill_order
    op: call_subworkflow
    params:
      workflow_id: fulfillment_subworkflow
      input:
        order_id: "{{order_result.order_id}}"
    output: fulfillment_result

  - id: extract_fulfillment_status
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: "{{fulfillment_result}}"
      field: status
    output: fulfillment_status

  - id: notify_customer
    op: notify_user
    params:
      recipient: "{{auth_context.user_email}}"
      subject: "Order Fulfilled"
      message: "Your order {{order_result.order_id}} has been fulfilled. Status: {{fulfillment_status}}"
    output: notification_result

  - id: log_purchase
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: "purchase_completed"
      order_id: "{{order_result.order_id}}"
      user_id: "{{auth_context.user_id}}"
      fulfillment_status: "{{fulfillment_status}}"
      timestamp: "{{now}}"
    output: audit_log_entry
